literature_claim_unverified.brainpfn_0.552: could not be verified in the paper text; the verified numbers are F-BERT 0.627 and Tucker 0.571 on Schaefer-400

why_this_matters: This is the direct answer to the 'not the official code' worry. On the literature's own parcellation family our pipeline gives 0.34, far below the 0.55-ish literature values. Part of the gap is that our ICA ensemble (0.63) is simply much stronger than the surface-parcellation numbers, but it also means we cannot yet claim our reimplementation equals theirs.
